findings.title: Alias action messages are not distinguished

support.quote: Cancel the scheduled removal of @${handle}.

findings.failure: Schedule, keep, and reactivate could all return the schedule dialog and still pass. Their distinct titles, buttons, and explanations are public policy outputs.
findings.correction: Use explicit expected titles, buttons, and action-specific explanation fragments for each command.

findings.title: Polling and owner clearing share an unrelated test

test.quote: it('pauses import polling during writes and purges only resolved session transitions', () => {

support.quote: export function shouldClearOwnerProfile(

findings.failure: A polling assertion failure prevents the independent owner-transition checks from running, coupling diagnosis and maintenance of two separate policies.
findings.correction: Separate polling and owner-clearing tests, retaining each policy's related cases together.

findings.title: Successful signing is verified only by shape and round trip

support.quote: HMAC signing and cursor expiration still enforced

findings.failure: Encode and decode could both use a key-dependent constant signature instead of authenticating the payload. Round trips, different-key rejection, and the supplied invalid fixtures would still pass, allowing payload tampering.
findings.correction: Verify the encoded signature against an independently calculated HMAC and reject an encoded cursor whose valid payload is modified while retaining its original signature.

findings.title: Blank-input rejection and write isolation are untested

support.quote: Blank input returns Invalid and never calls write.

findings.failure: Save could write blank input and return Saved while the sole nonblank scenario still passes.
findings.correction: Add a blank-input scenario asserting Invalid and an empty write log.

findings.title: Pending interval is its own expected value

support.quote: Pending and retrying poll at 5000ms unless writing.

findings.failure: Returning any deterministic incorrect interval for idle pending status still passes because both sides call the same production calculation.
findings.correction: Assert that poll('pending',false) equals the independent literal 5000.

findings.title: Editor test asserts private storage instead of public value

support.quote: Private storage representation may change without breaking clients.

findings.failure: Renaming storage breaks the test despite correct public behavior; a broken value getter can pass while _draft remains correct.
findings.correction: Assert editor.value after calling set.

findings.title: Opaque scenario names hide the polling contract

support.quote: const [status,writing,expected]=cases[scenario]; assert.equal(poll(status,writing),expected);

findings.failure: The caller cannot explain which statuses, writing conditions, or expected intervals it checks without opening the helper and decoding arbitrary names.
findings.correction: Declare explicit status, writing, and expected tuples in the test and pass them to a parameterized assertion helper.

findings.title: Independent polling and ownership checks share a failure path

support.quote: Polling and session ownership are independent policies.

findings.failure: A polling failure prevents all ownership assertions from executing, making unrelated session behavior depend on polling success for diagnosis.
findings.correction: Split the test into polling and session-ownership scenarios.

findings.title: Identity wrapper repeats the complete polling matrix

support.quote: A higher-level identity wrapper adds no translation, synchronization or browser risk.

findings.failure: Every policy change requires reviewing duplicate wider-boundary cases that exercise the same calculation without a distinct integration risk.
findings.correction: Keep the matrix at the public poll boundary and remove the duplicate screen matrix.

findings.title: Optional: flatten suites surrounding one interval assertion

support.quote: Nesting and snapshot size are optional advisory observations only; no numerical limit is repository policy.

findings.failure: Four suite contexts distribute one simple scenario's meaning across several labels, requiring readers to reconstruct the condition before reaching its sole assertion.
findings.correction: Optionally replace the nested suites with a directly named test such as 'pending polls every 5000ms when idle'.
